main.description:
Recovery hatch: replace a stewarded arbiter's configuration record
wholesale.

The caller authenticates via serviceAuth (aud = arbiter-server DID,
lxm = town.muni.arbiter.resetConfig). Only the account designated in
the arbiter's `town.muni.arbiter.recovery/self` record (the recovery
admin) may reset; the record is re-read from the repo on every call, so
rewriting it rotates the recovery admin with effect on the next call.

This endpoint never evaluates the policy pipeline and works while the
arbiter is offboarded (a broken config is exactly what it repairs): the
`town.muni.arbiter.config/self` record is replaced verbatim (putRecord
with swap_commit CAS, the same machinery as installPolicy) and the
arbiter is re-onboarded. The body is shape-validated only — no pipeline
compile checks and no record-existence checks: if the new config also
fails to load, reset again.

arbiterDid.description: The stewarded account whose configuration to replace.

trustedScopes.description:
NSID scopes (e.g. `community.lexicon.authCalendar`) the arbiter accepts.
A scoped proxy request's scope — its NSID with the `.arbiter.proxy` suffix
stripped — must be exactly one of these entries. Written to the arbiter's
`town.muni.arbiter.config/self` record verbatim.

policyLayers.description:
Ordered `at://` URIs of `town.muni.arbiter.policy` records forming the
policy layers. Written to the arbiter's `town.muni.arbiter.config/self`
record verbatim; entries are not validated beyond their shape — if the
new config fails to load, reset again.

errors.name: ErrPermissionDenied
errors.description:
The caller is not the recovery admin designated in
`town.muni.arbiter.recovery/self`, no (valid) recovery admin is
designated there, or the account is not stewarded by this server.
